perform the wireless communication with the external electronic device based on the third channel attribute, wherein the frequency band or the bandwidth included in the third channel attribute is less than the frequency band or the bandwidth included in the first channel attribute.

4. The electronic device (101, 201) of claim 1, wherein the processor (120) is configured to: perform the wireless communication with the external electronic device based on the second channel attribute by using a notice of absence, NoA, defined in the Wi-Fi protocol.
